normalization: 'Aqua/Water/Eau' is one entry; marker '*' stripped from Polyimide-1 and Polyquaternium-10 (kept as provenance). Normalized positions = packet positions.
surfactantArchitecture: Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate (2, strong anionic sulfonate type, defining); Cocamidopropyl Betaine (4, amphoteric buffer); Coco-Glucoside (11, nonionic glucoside buffer); Cocamide MIPA (3, alkanolamide thickener, not a route). No reinforcing strong anionic.

cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: defining anionic is ether/sulfonate type with at least one prominent buffer and no prominent reinforcing strong anionic -> moderate. Olefin sulfonate at 2 buffered by CAPB (4) and Coco-Glucoside (11).
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Two payload oils (7, 8), three cationic polymers and weak refatters argue for a softer net feel; sulfonate is a robust anionic. Neither moves the C1 convention.

conditioningLevel.rationale: C2 met: prominent payload lipids Cocos Nucifera Oil (7) and Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil (8) take the early-silicone place; cationic polymers Polyquaternium-10 (13), Polyquaternium-7 (15), Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (18); pearlizing route Glycol Distearate (21); deliberate humectants Glycerin (5), Panthenol (10). Film former Polyimide-1 (12) and weak refatters (14, 16) add further routes. Multiple complementary systems -> high.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: No silicone; oils sit after Sodium Chloride, so their level is bounded. Strong-ish sulfonate chassis does not lower conditioning (C2).

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: W-RICH holds (prominent oils converging with three cationic polymers), but reset is not limited (C1 sulfonate chassis, resetCapacity moderate), there is no silicone, and the oils are bounded by position; noticeable but bounded residue is the best-supported reading.

depositionLoad.rationale: Three cationic polymers (13, 15, 18), two prominent payload oils (7, 8), a film former (12) and two weak refatters (14, 16) converge.

persistence.rationale: Cationic polymers can build up, film former adds some persistence; no silicone or waxy lipid; liquid oils largely rinse in a sulfonate chassis.

resetCapacity.rationale: C1 moderate chassis: olefin sulfonate buffered by betaine and glucoside; effective ordinary reset, not limited.

weightPotential.counterSignal: W-RICH present and three cationic polymers plus a film former is a lot of converging deposition; the heavier band is realistic.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Deposition is clearly plausible across several families, so calling it light would understate residue; W-RICH is present.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: W-RICH alone does not reach high without limited reset (6.7 limited reset); the olefin sulfonate chassis is an effective reset, there is no silicone or waxy lipid, and the oils sit after Sodium Chloride, so a coating, movement-reducing result is not the best-supported reading.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Unknown polymer charge density/levels and oil levels could move it to high.
ruleNotes: W3 considered: moderate judged better supported, not closely balanced

focusPrimary.rationale: PROVISIONAL (blind): claims, name and usage directions hidden (3.1); final value set after unblinding (3.2). Formula is a rich care architecture compatible with moisture or repair; claims will decide (dual_supported tie-break needs a moderate/high claim).

careDirection.basis: Moisture: Glycerin (5), Panthenol (10) plus emollient oils and cationic polymers. Repair/nourishment: substantive deposition cluster of oils, three cationic polymers and a film former. Neither direction dominates on formula alone.

formulaCompatibleRoutes: moisture: Glycerin 5, Panthenol 10, Cocos Nucifera Oil 7
repair: Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil 8, Polyquaternium-10 13, Polyquaternium-7 15, Polyimide-1 12
focusPrimary.counterSignal: Formula alone does not distinguish moisture from repair.
